Smoke test: load racket and parse a simple snippet

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"language\":\"racket\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "#lang racket\n(define x 1)", config: configObj)
print(result)
```
